test_title: PYST 49: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My friends, being incredibly nerdy linguists, ______ to make fun of the syntax.
solution:
The correct answer is "**decided**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** In the given sentence, the blank will indicate how the friends made up their mind to make fun of the syntax.**
 
• **"Decided" is the most appropriate option as it fits the context of the sentence and makes grammatical sense.**
 
 
• The verb "decided" means to come to a resolution or make up one's mind about something.(फैसला किया)
 
 
• Example: I have decided to quit my job.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• My friends, being incredibly nerdy linguists, decided__ to make fun of the syntax.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "traded", means to exchange something for something else. (एक वस्‍तु देकर दूसरी वस्‍तु लेना, वस्‍तु-विनिमय करना)
 
• Option 2, "braided" means to join three or more pieces of hair or string-like material by putting them over each other in a special pattern.(लट)
 
• Option 4, "stalked" means to move slowly and quietly towards an animal in order to catch or kill it.(पीछा)
